units.source_text: 春天日子很长，源氏公子旅居无事，便乘暮霭沉沉的时候，散步到坡下那所屋宇的茅垣旁边。

en.t: In spring the days were long, and Prince Genji, idle in his temporary lodging, took advantage of the deepening evening mist to stroll beside the brushwood fence of the house below the slope.

units.source_text: 他叫别的随从都回寺里去，只带惟光一人。

en.t: He sent all his other attendants back to the temple and took only Koremitsu with him.

units.source_text: 向屋内窥探一下，正好窥见向西的一个房间里供着佛像，一个修行的尼姑把帘子卷起些，正在佛前供花。

en.t: Peering inside, he happened to see a Buddhist image enshrined in a west-facing room, where a nun in religious practice had rolled up the blinds a little and was offering flowers before the Buddha.

units.source_text: 后来她靠着室中的柱子坐下，将佛经放在一张矮几上，十分辛苦地念起经来。

en.t: Afterward she sat leaning against a pillar in the room, placed a sutra on a low table, and began reciting it with great effort.

units.source_text: 看她的样子，不是一个平凡的人。

en.t: From her appearance, she was plainly no ordinary person.

units.source_text: 年纪约有四十光景，肤色皙白，仪态高贵，身体虽瘦，而面庞饱满，眉清目秀。

en.t: She seemed to be about forty; her skin was fair, her bearing noble, and though her body was thin, her face was full and her brows and eyes were refined and beautiful.

units.source_text: 头发虽已剪短[\[3\]](#part1334.html#m3)，反比长发美丽得多，颇有新颖之感，源氏公子看了觉得很愉快。

en.t: Although her hair had already been cut short[\[3\]](#part1334.html#m3), it was far more beautiful than long hair and had a fresh charm; Prince Genji found it pleasing to look at.

units.source_text: 尼姑身旁有两个相貌清秀的中年侍女，又有几个女孩走进走出，正在戏耍。

en.t: Beside the nun were two middle-aged gentlewomen with graceful features, and several little girls were going in and out as they played.

units.source_text: 其中有一个女孩[\[4\]](#part1334.html#m4)，年约十岁光景，白色衬衣上罩着一件棣棠色外衣，正向这边跑来。

en.t: Among them was one girl[\[4\]](#part1334.html#m4), about ten years old, wearing a kerria-yellow outer robe over a white undergarment, who came running this way.

units.source_text: 这女孩的模样，和以前看到的许多孩子完全不同，非常可爱，设想将来长大起来，定是一个绝色美人。

en.t: This girl's appearance was completely unlike that of the many children he had seen before; she was extraordinarily lovely, and one could imagine that when she grew up she would surely be a peerless beauty.

units.source_text: 她的扇形的头发披展在肩上，随着脚步而摆动。

en.t: Her fan-shaped hair spread over her shoulders and swayed with each step.

units.source_text: 由于哭泣，脸都揉红了。

en.t: Because she had been crying, her face was rubbed red.

units.source_text: 她走到尼姑面前站定，尼姑抬起头来，问道：“你怎么了？

en.t: She came up before the nun and stopped; the nun raised her head and asked, "What is the matter?

units.source_text: 和孩子们吵架了么？”

en.t: Did you quarrel with the other children?"

units.source_text: 两人的面貌略有相似之处。

en.t: The two faces bore a slight resemblance to each other.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“莫非是这尼姑的女儿？”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "Could she be this nun's daughter?"

units.source_text: 但见这女孩诉说道：“犬君[\[5\]](#part1334.html#m5)把小麻雀放走了，我好好地关在熏笼里的。”

en.t: But then the girl complained, "Inuki[\[5\]](#part1334.html#m5) let the little sparrow go, even though I had shut it carefully inside the incense cage."

units.source_text: 说时表示很可惜的样子。

en.t: As she said this, she looked very sorry about it.

units.source_text: 旁边一个侍女言道：“这个粗手粗脚的丫头，又闯祸了，该骂她一顿。

en.t: A lady-in-waiting nearby said, "That clumsy girl has caused trouble again; she ought to be scolded.

units.source_text: 真可惜呢！

en.t: What a pity!

units.source_text: 那小麻雀不知飞到哪里去了，近来越养越可爱了。

en.t: Who knows where that little sparrow has flown? It had grown more and more adorable lately.

units.source_text: 不要被乌鸦看见才好。”

en.t: I only hope the crows do not spot it."

units.source_text: 说着便走出去。

en.t: Saying this, she went outside.

units.source_text: 她的头发又密又长，体态十分轻盈。

en.t: Her hair was thick and long, and her figure moved with great lightness.

units.source_text: 人们称她“少纳言乳母”，大概是这女孩的保姆。

en.t: People called her "Shonagon the nurse," so she was probably the girl's nursemaid.

units.source_text: 尼姑说：“唉！

en.t: The nun said, "Ah!

units.source_text: 不懂事的孩子！

en.t: What a thoughtless child!

units.source_text: 说这些无聊的话！

en.t: Saying such foolish things!

units.source_text: 我这条性命今天不知道明天，你全不想想，只知道玩麻雀。

en.t: My life may not last from today to tomorrow, yet you think nothing of it and care only about playing with sparrows.

units.source_text: 玩弄生物是罪过的，我不是常常对你说的么？”

en.t: Toying with living creatures is a sin; have I not told you that again and again?"

units.source_text: 接着又对她说：“到这里来！”

en.t: Then she said to her again, "Come here!"

units.source_text: 那女孩便在尼姑身旁坐下。

en.t: The girl then sat down beside the nun.

units.source_text: 女孩的相貌非常可爱，眉梢流露清秀之气，额如敷粉，披在脑后的短发俊美动人。

en.t: The girl's face was exceedingly lovely; her brows had an air of delicate refinement, her forehead was as pale as if powdered, and the short hair falling behind her head was handsome and moving.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想道：“这个人长大起来，多么娇艳啊！”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "How radiant she will be when she grows up!"

units.source_text: 便目不转睛地注视她。

en.t: He gazed at her without taking his eyes away.

units.source_text: 继而又想：“原来这孩子的相貌，非常肖似我所倾心爱慕的那个人[\[6\]](#part1334.html#m6)，所以如此牵惹我的心目。”

en.t: Then he thought, "So that is why this child's face so closely resembles the person I love and long for with all my heart[\[6\]](#part1334.html#m6), and why she draws my eyes and heart so strongly."

units.source_text: 想到这里，不禁流下泪来。

en.t: Thinking this, he could not help shedding tears.
